comment: Which open font stands in for each Windows 98 scalable face.
Milestone 0 of docs/scalable-font-design.md. This file is the single
source that the browser @font-face block, the Node FontLibrary.use
registration, and the WAT EnumFontFamiliesEx inventory all read, so they
cannot drift apart. Microsoft font binaries are never committed.
cssFamily is deliberately private and never the Win98 name: registering a
family as 'Arial' invites the host's own Arial to win the cascade on some
machines and lose on others, which is the exact non-determinism this
effort removes. The names disappear entirely once the WAT rasterizer
lands and the hosts stop being told these fonts exist.
win98Files names the file each style occupies in a real C:\WINDOWS\FONTS.
The host mounts the vendored substitute at that VFS path, so WAT asks for
ARIAL.TTF exactly as Win98 GDI would and never learns that Liberation
Sans is what answers. Which open font stands in stays entirely host-side,
matching how the bundled .FON strikes already load. Faces with no real
Win98 TrueType file (Small Fonts shipped as SMALLE.FON) have no entry.

tiers.1: Metric-compatible: identical advance widths, different outlines. Guest layout math is exactly right.
tiers.2: Wine's own Win9x substitute, already a project dependency.
tiers.3: Visual approximation with different metrics, documented as such.

faces.note: The Win98 shell and tooltip font. Its embedded monochrome EBDT strikes cover exactly the ppem range dialogs use, so at UI sizes Tahoma belongs on the existing pixel-exact .FON blit rather than on any rasterizer.
Hidden face carrying the title-bar and checkbox glyphs. 39 glyphs covers its full set.
Wine drew only 53 of the ~220 Wingdings glyphs. A codepoint Wine never drew resolves to .notdef; this is a known hole, not a bug to hunt.
10 glyphs only. Severely partial; listed so a guest asking for the face gets a deterministic answer rather than a host font.

comment: Win98 faces with no vendored substitute. Each is added only when a
corpus binary actually names it: an unused font in fonts/ is a licence
and payload liability, not a feature.
unsubstituted.Verdana: DejaVu Sans is the closest open option, with different metrics
unsubstituted.Comic Sans MS: Comic Relief is metric-compatible but GPL+FE; needs a licence review before vendoring
unsubstituted.Impact: Anton is a visual approximation only
unsubstituted.Microsoft Sans Serif: the outline form of MS Sans Serif, whose bitmap strikes are already served by MSSansSerif.fon
